entries.description: the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove
entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

entries.task_id: how|can|i prevent my wealth from being taken by rulers or bandits
entries.description: How can I prevent my wealth from being taken by rulers or bandits
entries.subject: How
entries.object: I prevent my wealth from being taken by rulers or bandits

spans.text: So tesaṁ bhogānaṁ ārakkhādhikaraṇaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti: But they experience pain and sadness when they try to protect it, thinking: ‘kinti me bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṁ, na corā hareyyuṁ, na aggi daheyya, na udakaṁ vaheyya, na appiyā dāyādā hareyyun’ti. ‘How can I prevent my wealth from being taken by rulers or bandits, consumed by fire, swept away by flood, or taken by unloved heirs?’

entries.description: So socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṁ kandati
entries.subject: So

spans.text: So socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṁ kandati, sammohaṁ āpajjati: They sorrow and wail and lament, beating their breast and falling into confusion: ‘yampi me ahosi tampi no natthī’ti. ‘What once was mine is gone.’
